hints.title: Fruit Difference Sign Convention
hints.text: The problem requires apples sold minus oranges sold for each sale date.

hints.title: Conditional Summation by Date
hints.text: Calculate sum(case when fruit = "apples" then sold_num else -sold_num end) grouped by sale_date.

hints.title: Chronological Output Sort
hints.text: order by sale_date to present results sequentially.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT sale_date,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fruit = 'apples' THEN sold_num ELSE -sold_num END) AS diff
FROM Sales
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date;
```

complexity.notes: Group-by aggregation over sale_date takes linear time followed by sorting distinct dates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-joining Sales on sale_date with fruit equality requires two table passes and handles missing fruit types awkwardly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Signed CASE summation groups all fruits for a date in a single table pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Conditional aggregation mapping categories to positive and negative values.
